subject: Aligning VP/CTO slots across time zones — Bluecord kickoff
messages:
From: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@bluecord.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>
Cc: James O'Connor <j.oconnor@bluecord.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 15:12:00 -0400
Subject: VP/CTO on kickoff — availability & ask

Hi Priya,

Thanks again for the intro at the end of last week. We're excited to get a short, executive-focused walkthrough of Redwood to align our leadership before we move into procurement. Two asks up-front:

1) Can we secure a 30-minute slot with either your VP of Sales/Customer Success (for business fit) and preferably a very short CTO presence (10–15 mins) to confirm integration considerations?
2) We're distributed across US East (Marta) and London (James). We'd like to propose windows that accommodate both — ideally late-morning ET or early afternoon GMT.

Suggested target week: Nov 1–5. We don't need a full deep-dive — more of a sponsor intro and confirmation of technical footprint.

I've copied James to coordinate the CTO ask. If you can propose 2–3 concrete slots, we'll lock one.

Thanks,
Marta Ruiz
Head of Partnerships | Bluecord Systems
Attachments: none

From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@bluecord.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.ai>, James O'Connor <j.oconnor@bluecord.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 16:02:00 -0400
Subject: Re: VP/CTO on kickoff — availability & ask

Hi Marta — great to meet you (virtually).

We can absolutely set up a compact sponsor intro + a short CTO check-in. Looping in Marissa (AE) to drive the scheduling and Avery (Sales Ops) to ensure we give you options that work across time zones and preserve a CTO window.

A few quick items that will help us recommend the best attendees and length:
- Would you prefer the VP + CTO together for 30 minutes, or VP for 30 with a 10–15 min CTO handoff?
- Any hard constraints on days/times in the week of Nov 1–5?
- If you can confirm the CTO's name/email, we can invite them directly for the short technical touchpoint.

Marissa — can you propose two viable windows that give a ~10–15 min overlap for a CTO in London and a 30-min slot for our VP in ET? Preferably we’ll offer one morning ET / evening GMT and one that is late morning GMT / late afternoon ET.

Thanks — I’ll draft an agenda once we lock a time.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Senior Solutions Lead | Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0176

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@bluecord.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.ai>, James O'Connor <j.oconnor@bluecord.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 19:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: VP/CTO on kickoff — availability & ask

Thanks Priya — happy to coordinate. Per our leadership calendars I can offer the following two distinct options (both 30-min sponsor sessions; CTO asked to join first 10–15 mins):

Option A (ET-friendly):
- Tue, Nov 2 — 11:00 AM ET / 4:00 PM UK (30 minutes)

Option B (UK-friendly):
- Thu, Nov 4 — 2:00 PM ET / 7:00 PM UK (30 minutes)

If neither works we can also propose Wed Nov 3 at 12:30 PM ET / 5:30 PM UK as a middle ground.

Agenda (draft):
- 0:00–0:05 — quick intros and success criteria (sponsor level)
- 0:05–0:20 — Redwood value for Bluecord (business fit + cost/latency summary)
- 0:20–0:30 — CTO touchpoint: integration constraints & next technical steps
\Notes on attendees: Priya will host; our recommended internal attendees are VP, Solutions (prepped), and a short CTO attendance.

Marta/James — which of A/B (or the Wed middle) is best for you? If you confirm, I’ll send a calendar invite and attach a brief kickoff agenda.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole | Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: James O'Connor <j.oconnor@bluecord.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@bluecord.com>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>, Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 08:05:00 +01:00
Subject: Re: VP/CTO on kickoff — availability & ask

Hi all — thanks for the clear options. We prefer Option A (Tue, Nov 2 at 11:00 AM ET / 4:00 PM UK). That's the best for our CTO (Edda Berg). I'll forward Edda's calendar invite once I confirm — she can join for the first 15 minutes to validate integration scope.

Couple of quick notes from our side:
- Please include a 1-page technical checklist or simple architecture slide in the invite so Edda has visibility in advance.
- We attached a short Bluecord kickoff agenda for your reference (topic priorities).

Looking forward — James
James O'Connor
Director of Platform Engineering | Bluecord Systems
Attachments: Bluecord_kickoff_priorities.pdf (application/pdf)

Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 09:05:00 +01:00
Subject: Re: VP/CTO on kickoff — availability & ask

Perfect — thanks James (and Marta). Option A accepted. Per request we attached a one-page technical snapshot and the proposed kickoff agenda. I'll send a calendar invite with the 30-minute block and mark the first 15 minutes as "CTO requested attendance" so Edda can pop off after the integration check.

Quick logistics we will add to the invite:
- Dial-in: Zoom link (will be in calendar invite)
- Prep doc: redwood short technical snapshot (attached)
- Owner: Marissa (AE) will run the meeting; Priya will lead the sponsor portion.

Attachments included: redwood_tech_snapshot_onepager.pdf, redwood_invite.ics

See you Nov 2 — I'll follow up with the calendar invite in 10–15 mins.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Senior Solutions Lead | Redwood Inference
